title: Similar - Pilot Line Final-Test Reason Cleanup
goal: Normalize multilingual pilot-line final-test and burn-in failure remarks into product-specific standard reason codebooks, preserving substring spans, handling multi-segment notes, respecting station scope, and emitting calibrated confidence with UNKNOWN when evidence is weak.
skillBenefitRationale: This is the closest typical use of the shipped skill: engineers write noisy mixed-language failure reasons that must be segmented and mapped into standardized product codebooks with station-aware validation and confidence calibration.
